streak_assessment: Consecutive scientific non-improvements = 0. exp-0089 was promoted on 2026-09-03 (14-12-6, score 0.625, 90% interval [0.522, 0.718], statistical_decision "accept"), with a clean CI: zero stress failures (worst move 0.807 s against the 2.25 s ceiling at the 120 s clock, 0.042 s against 0.75 s at the 1 s clock), 12 divergent model-move-ablation comparisons, ruff/mypy/pytest green. That promotion broke the twelve-candidate search/ordering/quiescence/time plateau (exp-0076..exp-0088) by changing the leaf evaluation rather than the search, and reset the streak. The search/move-ordering/quiescence/time-management direction is genuinely saturated in its tested form (that whole family is on the exhausted list and a long run of inconclusive results confirms it), but the newly opened direction — hand-scaled positional terms added to the previously position-blind tapered-PSQT leaf — is not saturated: exactly one such term (net mobility) has been tried and it barely cleared the bar, and several cheap, well-motivated positional terms remain completely untested in the arena. The handoff stop rule (>= 5 consecutive non-improvements AND no materially new hypothesis) is not close to met.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced threefold-repetition draws from balanced or clearly better positions dominate the retained evidence (12 of 32 games). The PGNs show the engine oscillating pieces (rook shuffles Rh3/Re3, knight tours Nc3/Na2, king wobble Kg2/Kh2, Rg8/Rg4) in positions with no progress plan, and the tapered PSQT plus the single mobility term give alpha-beta no gradient toward making progress once development is finished.

Every retained loss (6 of 6: reti, french, caro-kann, nimzo-indian, slav, alekhine) ends in checkmate. The engine repeatedly allows its own king to be hunted — sometimes in the middlegame with an uncastled/exposed king after an early queen sortie (reti, ~move 30, Kf1 with Bg3+/Qf3+/Qf2+/Qf1#), and repeatedly in long rook/queen/king-and-pawn endgames (french 51, caro-kann 51, nimzo 58, slav 64, alekhine 71 moves) where a king-hunt mating net forms. The champion has no attacker-aware king term at all — only a flat WEIGHTS[CASTLING_OFFSET] scalar for surviving castling rights.

Endgame conversion / winning-technique weakness: several equal-or-better endgames drift into repetition draws or are lost outright. There is no passed-pawn, rook-on-open-file, king-activity or bishop-pair term, so the search cannot distinguish a winning plan (push the passer, seize the open file) from shuffling.

next_direction.title: Non-linear king-danger term in the leaf evaluation
next_direction.hypothesis: Adding a cheap non-linear king-danger term to _model_evaluate reduces the recurring checkmate losses and converts some balanced-or-better shuffling draws into wins, without retraining. Inside the existing per-piece loop in _model_evaluate, OR every piece's board.attacks_mask(square) — including both kings — into one Python int attack-bitboard per colour. After the loop, for each side compute ring_bb = chess.BB_KING_ATTACKS[board.king(colour)] and d = chess.popcount(enemy_attack_bb & ring_bb), clamp d to a small cap, and add sign * -KS_WEIGHT * d * d to score (the sign loop already alternates the side-to-move perspective, so this simultaneously penalises danger around the mover's king and rewards pressure on the opponent's king). The quadratic shape gives alpha-beta a monotone, sharply rising reason to keep its own king shielded and to press an attack on an exposed enemy king that the flat castling scalar cannot express.
next_direction.rationale: All six retained losses in exp-0089's own arena are checkmates, spanning both a middlegame king hunt with an uncastled king and several 50-70 move endgame king hunts, and the champion has literally no attacker-aware king term. The only prior king-safety attempt was a six-feature LINEAR trained residual that showed no offline signal and never reached the arena; a direct non-linear attacker-count penalty computed in agent.py is a materially different mechanism and is explicitly named as an open direction in the handoff. exp-0089 just demonstrated that a single cheap hand-scaled leaf term (mobility) can move the paired-arena score to 0.625 without touching the model, and reusing the attack masks already gathered in the mobility loop makes the added cost a handful of int-ORs and two popcounts per leaf. This is preferred over another progress-signal term (passed pawns) because it attacks the loss column directly rather than piling a second term onto the same sub-direction mobility already addressed.
next_direction.guardrails: Reuse the existing piece loop only: accumulate attacks_mask into two Python ints (add the two kings, which the loop currently skips), with no second legal-move generation and no per-leaf object allocation beyond those two ints and the ring lookup. Use only documented python-chess API (board.king, board.attacks_mask or chess.BB_KING_ATTACKS, chess.popcount); never read library internals or any path outside agent.py and weights/. Clamp d at roughly 6 and fix KS_WEIGHT near 2-3 centipawns so the worst-case penalty stays around 0.8-1.1 pawn and only in genuine mating attacks, while a typical position stays well under a third of a pawn and far below the model's ~118 cp margin RMSE, keeping the trained PSQT and the accepted mobility term dominant. No change to _budget_seconds or the iterative-deepening loop. Must hold model-ablation minimum_strength_score >= 0.625 with >= 8 divergent moves, and pass the full stress_time_left_ms grid (1/25/100/1000/120000) with required_failures 0; exp-0089's worst single move was 0.807 s against the 2.25 s ceiling at the 120 s clock and 0.042 s against 0.75 s at the 1 s clock, so the extra popcounts must keep leaf cost within roughly 1.3x. If the arena is inconclusive, do NOT merely retune KS_WEIGHT, the cap, or the ring definition: move to the next distinct positional term (passed pawns, then rook-on-open-file, then bishop pair). If a direction later genuinely needs an offline-trained artifact (a positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json), flag that for the human rather than expanding candidate permissions.

audit_summary: The current champion is agent.py at commit 4a0c988 (recorded as exp-0089): a mature PVS/LMR search with an exchange-aware capture-ordering/pruning quiescence, transposition table, partial root-iteration salvage, and a fast draw/terminal path, over a tapered piece-square learned model, plus the newly accepted fixed 3 cp/square net-mobility leaf term and a flat castling-rights scalar. exp-0089 was promoted at score 0.625 (interval [0.522, 0.718], 14-12-6) with a clean reliability and ablation CI, resetting the scientific non-improvement streak to 0 and breaking the exp-0076..exp-0088 search/ordering/quiescence/time plateau. Auditing exp-0089's retained games: the dominant failure mode is non-forced threefold-repetition draws from balanced or better positions (12 of 32 games, with visible aimless piece-shuffling), and every one of the six losses is a checkmate, occurring both in a middlegame king hunt with an uncastled king and in several long rook/queen/king-and-pawn endgame king hunts. The search/move-ordering/quiescence/time direction is saturated in its tested form, but the leaf-evaluation direction opened by exp-0089 is not: only mobility has been tried, and non-linear king safety, passed pawns, rook-on-open-file, and bishop pair remain untested in the arena. Decision: CONTINUE. The next experiment adds a cheap non-linear (attacker-count-squared) king-danger term to _model_evaluate, reusing the attack masks already gathered for the mobility loop, with a small hand-chosen coefficient (~2-3 cp) and an attacker-count cap (~6), keeping the trained model dominant. This is distinct from the exhausted six-feature linear king-safety residual (no offline signal, never arena-tested). If it fails, passed pawns, rook-on-open-file, bishop pair, and ultimately a positional-feature offline retrain (to be flagged for the human) remain before true scientific saturation. Uploading remains out of scope; the protected champion is newer and better supported than the live exp-0052-era upload.
